cluster_stories.title: China Blocks Meta’s Acquisition of AI Startup Manus
cluster_stories.summary: China has decided to block Meta's $2 billion acquisition of agentic AI startup Manus, in a surprise move to unwind a controversial deal. The decision is likely to send a chill through China’s AI sector and emerged just weeks before a summit between US President Donald Trump and China’s Xi Jinping. Bloomberg's Neil Campling reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

cluster_stories.title: Microsoft to end exclusive license for OpenAI's technology
cluster_stories.summary: Microsoft's exclusive hold on OpenAI's artificial intelligence models is over. This change allows OpenAI to offer its technology to competitors like Amazon and Google. Microsoft will still be OpenAI's main cloud partner and has licensing rights until 2032. This development impacts the ongoing artificial intelligence race.
